# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and memory hardening** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers targeted performance wins, memory-safety fixes, and the Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. This release adds the new Skia Graphite rendering backend (Vulkan, Metal, Dawn), fixes several native use-after-free and memory leaks, reduces allocations across hot paths, and pulls in the latest chrome/m151 upstream stability fixes. WASM gains .NET 11 support via Emscripten 5.0.6.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m151 and upstream stability syncs** — Multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes have been applied, pulling in correctness and stability improvements from the Skia team. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — Full C# bindings for Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering backend are now available, enabling hardware-accelerated rendering via Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn on supported platforms. ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels for SKImage and SKSurface** — A new async pixel-read API lets callers request pixel data from any GPU backend without stalling the GPU pipeline. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — Hex color parsing is faster and allocates less, and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads let callers parse colors from stack or sliced buffers. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET convenience package wires up Silk.NET Vulkan interop so consumers can create a GRContext with minimal boilerplate. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Containerized test targets: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — CI now validates SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server, and these targets are included in the shipped native asset set. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* fixed** — The pixel-source SKBitmap or SKData could be collected before the derived SKPixmap finished using it; the root object is now kept alive for the lifetime of the pixmap. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator fixed** — The parent SKRegion could be garbage-collected mid-iteration; it is now rooted for the iterator's lifetime. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed** — When the native raster image creation failed, the unmanaged pixel buffer was not freed; the leak is now closed. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Binding generation is now deterministic across platforms** — The P/Invoke binding generator produces bit-identical output regardless of the build machine OS, eliminating spurious diffs in generated files. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Platform

- **WASM .NET 11 support via Emscripten 5.0.6** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries with the new exnref exception-handling ABI are included, enabling SkiaSharp on .NET 11 WASM. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459))
- **Windows native build MSVC environment initialized once** — The MSVC toolchain environment is now set up once per native build invocation instead of per-target, reducing build time on Windows. ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
- **FreeType font support for Windows Nano Server** — Nano Server now uses FreeType for font rendering, giving text-layout workloads a working font engine on that platform. ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## API Surface

- **SKData.SaveTo double-copy eliminated** — SKData.SaveTo previously copied data into an intermediate buffer before writing; it now writes directly, halving peak memory use for large payloads. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **HandleDictionary skip-registration check cached** — The per-type reflection check that decides whether to skip handle registration is now cached, removing a recurring reflection cost from the hot path. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))
- **GetEncodedText null-terminated path allocation removed** — The null-terminated text encoding path no longer allocates an intermediate string, reducing allocations in text measurement loops. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized** — The uniform-name lookup dictionary is now pre-sized to the known uniform count, avoiding rehash allocations on first populate. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release; highlights include an allocation-free AddUtf8(string) via pooled UTF-8 encoding and per-call char[] elimination in Tag.Parse.
